reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (§13.1 personnel access, §13.5 Employee NDA/invention warranty, §14.5 independent contractors, §14.10 integration, Exhibit D §5 staffing) contain no non-solicit, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant binding Corio (our party, the licensee/customer), so the clause set sits at the playbook's preferred position of 'no non-solicit on Customer'.
The failing deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts of there being no restrictive covenant to measure and do not undercut compliance.
The rationale correctly flags the incorporated separate NDA/SOW as a diligence item rather than treating it as a deviation, and states the fallback position accurately for future negotiation.
